Mr. Big Guy

The Rise and Fall of Curtis Slade

Written from the stark reality of a federal prison cell, MR. BIG GUY is an unflinching street memoir that pulls back the curtain on the South Florida underworld.

The hustle began in Dania Beach, but it wasn't meant to stay there. Curtis Slade and the First Street Boyz seized an opportunity to rewrite their destinies. What followed was a meteoric ascent into power, wealth, and the intoxicating allure of a street empire.

But the architecture of the underworld is built on loyalty—and loyalty is often an illusion.

As Curtis navigated his rising dominance, threats closed in from all sides. A trusted associate harbored a hidden, devastating agenda. Simultaneously, rival forces arrived to exact vengeance, determined to reclaim what Curtis and his crew had taken.

Stripped of the glamour and told with brutal honesty, MR. BIG GUY chronicles the intoxicating rush of ambition, the devastating sting of betrayal, and the harsh survival instinct required when the world you built turns against you.

Reader FAQ

What is this book about?

A gritty, true-to-life street memoir detailing ambition, loyalty, betrayal, and survival within the South Florida underworld, specifically following the First Street Boyz.

Who is the author?

Curtis Slade, who wrote and narrated this memoir directly from a federal prison cell.

Where does the story take place?

The events are primarily set in Dania Beach and the broader South Florida area.

Where can I buy it?

The book is available for purchase on Amazon.

Do I need a Kindle device to read it?

No. While it is a Kindle Edition, a Kindle device is not required. You can read it on any smartphone, tablet, or computer using the free Kindle app.
